Fiona completed 36 questions in the first hour.  
Shirley completed twice as many: 36 × 2 = 72 questions.  
Kiana completed half of the sum of Fiona and Shirley: (36 + 72) / 2 = 108 / 2 = 54 questions.  

In the first hour, total = 36 + 72 + 54 = 162 questions.  
In the second hour, each did the same number as in the first hour, so another 162 questions.  
Total over 2 hours = 162 + 162 = 324 questions.  

Final answer: 324
